changelog_text:
## Changes

- Add Facet Tracking Wing 2 and Tracking Wing 3. They are rated at 138 W and 207 W, respectively. Both track the Sun on one axis at up to 5 degrees per second. The original wings keep their part IDs and work as before in flight.
- Facet Bus avionics draw 25 W and have a power switch and status light. They have a radiation tolerance of 1000 Gy, an upset dose of 900 mSv and 1 g/cm2 of shielding.
- Facet Cube 3U, 6U and 12U avionics draw 1.5 W, 3 W and 6 W, respectively. Each has a power switch, a status light, a tolerance of 50 Gy, an upset dose of 45 mSv and 0.5 g/cm2 of shielding.
- Switch the Eye Imager (60 W) and Camera Pod (15 W) on and off independently. The Alcor Kick Engine has a gimbal slew limit of 6 degrees per second.
- Surface attachments on the Bus and Battery Pack use their physical shapes. The Battery Pack and Cube Adapter use stack placement. The original wings and Patch Antenna have new part picker angles.
- The Voyager Tank and RCS Pods keep their tank volume. With KSA 2026.11.16.5901's corrected MMH density of 880.58 kg/m3, the Voyager Tank holds about 414 kg of propellant and each RCS Pod holds about 11 kg.
- Existing part IDs and connector order stay the same.

## Compatibility

Validated against KSA build version **2026.11.16.5901**.

## Installation

Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\PurrlineFacet\`. No mod loader is needed.

listing.abstract: Satellite parts for small launchers: a rideshare rack with 3U, 6U and 12U cube satellites, and a kit to build small satellites and probes, with a bus, solar wings, instruments, antennas and the Alcor kick engine.
listing.description:
![Facet cube satellites on the rack](ksa-image:hero)

**Facet** is a set of satellite parts for small launchers in Kitten Space Agency, from the fictional rocket maker **Purrline Rocketworks**: a rideshare rack with cube satellites, and a kit to build small satellites and probes.

## Parts

- **Facet Cube Rack**: rideshare rack for cube satellites inside a fairing; bare, gold foil, white cloth.
- **Facet Cube Adapter 1 m to 0.5 m**: adapter from 1 m to 0.5 m; bare, gold foil, white cloth.
- **Facet Cube 3U**, **6U** and **12U**: cube satellites, two layouts each; the 12U unfolds its wings.
- **Facet Bus**: battery-powered core of a small satellite or probe, with a status light and radiation protection; bare, gold foil, white cloth.
- **Facet Battery Pack**: battery pack for the Bus; bare, gold foil, white cloth.
- **Facet RCS Pod**: attitude control thrusters with their own tank.
- **Facet Wing 2** and **Wing 3**: folding solar wings with two or three panels.
- **Facet Tracking Wing 2** and **Tracking Wing 3**: folding wings that turn towards the Sun after deployment, rated at 138 W and 207 W.
- **Facet Eye Imager**: Earth observation telescope; bare or with foil.
- **Facet Camera Pod**, **Star Tracker**, **Horn Antenna** and **Patch Antenna**.
- **Facet Dish**: deploying dish antenna.
- **Facet Science Boom**: deploying science boom.
- **Facet Voyager Tank**: propellant tank of a small probe; bare or in silver foil.
- **Alcor Kick Engine**: kick engine on stock MMH and NTO.

Sizes and texture density follow the stock parts. The cube satellites have their own battery-powered control and radiation protection. A Bus rides on a stock 0.5 m decoupler.

![Original parts and finishes](ksa-image:all-parts)

![Facet Eye](ksa-image:eye)

![Facet Voyager with the Alcor kick engine](ksa-image:voyager)

![Rideshare with white cloth](ksa-image:rideshare-cloth)

## Requirements

No other mod needed. Facet works with any launcher that has a fairing. [Prisma by Purrline Rocketworks](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-PurrlinePrisma) is a small launcher with a fairing for Facet.

## Install

- Borea: install Facet from the content list.
- By hand: copy `PurrlineFacet` from the release zip into `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency/mods/` and enable it.

To remove the mod, delete its folder. Vehicles with its parts do not load without it.

Made for KSA build 2026.11.16.5901.
